itineraries.title: Ancient Ruins, Modern Spoils - 5 Day Itinerary
editorial: Our five-day trip split naturally between Athens and Santorini, with Athens bookending the island visit.
What if we had more time?
We'd add another island rather than another day in Athens. Rhodes was our original thought, though the Greek islands are essentially a choose-your-own-adventure book.

days.title: Day 1 - Athens
editorial: Settle in and spend the evening around the tourist core below the Acropolis.
We caught a Greek play in English with the Acropolis as the backdrop. It was one of those experiences where the setting does most of the work—and we mean that as a compliment.

The surrounding streets are lively, full of rooftop restaurants, souvenir shops and people lingering well after dinner. Start with a gyro at Kostas; at roughly EUR3 when we visited, it was also a reminder that Athens can be surprisingly affordable for the Eurozone.

days.title: Day 2 - Athens
editorial: Make this your ancient-Greece day: the Acropolis, Parthenon and Theatre of Dionysus.

We booked a mythology-focused tour and discovered the obvious downside of a mythology-focused tour: there was more mythology than history or architecture. If the engineering, politics and construction interest you more than the gods, choose your guide accordingly.
Later, wander through the old neighbourhoods and stop at Yiasemi. We still remember an excellent plate of bird livers that cost about EUR5.

days.title: Day 3 - Santorini
editorial: Fly or ferry to Santorini and resist the urge to schedule too much.

The island is as photogenic as advertised, but it is also more enjoyable once you stop treating every blue dome as a checklist item. Check in, walk the caldera-facing lanes and let sunset be the main event.

days.title: Day 4 - Santorini
editorial: Give Santorini a full unhurried day. This is where a well-located stay matters more than it does in Athens: the less time you spend commuting to the postcard views, the better.
We'd use the day for villages, a long lunch and another sunset rather than trying to manufacture a packed sightseeing itinerary.

days.title: Day 5 - Athens
editorial: Return to Athens and climb Lycabettus Hill for a final view over the city. It is a good visual summary of Athens: dense modern sprawl with an ancient monument somehow still commanding the skyline.
